budget_policy: Review threshold, never permission to delete core state. A populated database and its durable event export can already exceed a small development-artifact budget; retired builds have no such exception.

artifacts.purpose: Current read model, historical settings, ingest evidence and cursors
artifacts.schema: SQLite schema.sql user_version 1, including required WAL/SHM side files
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: console_store health, run history and coverage queries
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Preserve the current consistent database. Backfill does not recreate all historical settings, failed ingest attempts or events outside the OS log window.

retention_rule.rule: Never removed or truncated by artifact cleanup; exceeding 128 MiB requires a separate reviewed migration.

artifacts.purpose: One compressed consistent database snapshot for versioned recovery
artifacts.schema: current.zip contains console.sqlite3 and schema_version 1 receipt.json; current.json mirrors the receipt and archive digest
artifacts.producer: tools/backup_console_db.py manual refresh or scheduled bound-source publication
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Private backup and verified database recovery
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Verify the archive before extraction. Restore only with the writer stopped and original state preserved.

retention_rule.rule: Keep one verified snapshot; reuse it if database bytes and schema/counts are unchanged. Scheduled mode commits and pushes only its pair through normal hooks on private main, rejecting unrelated staged or unpublished work. Never prune it as development output.

artifacts.purpose: Durable normalized run events beyond the rotating OS log window
artifacts.schema: JSONL e,r,t,i,ts,rc; event identity is e+r
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Export watermark and durable event history
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Keep versioned in the private companion. It does not contain every database column or provide a complete database restore.

retention_rule.rule: Append without loss; report above 48 MiB for explicit partition or migration review, never silently discard old events.

artifacts.purpose: Current registration authority and transaction recovery
artifacts.schema: Current pointer, transaction journals, receipts, stages and locks
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Registration recovery and launcher authority
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the pointer with its referenced receipt and journal; preserve pending, conflict and uncleaned transactions. Pair current authority with the current protected-input archive declared by the private configuration backup owner's storage contract; see docs/storage.md for the manifest and DPAPI limits.

retention_rule.rule: Artifact cleanup never touches registration; review completed transactions separately above 8 MiB.

artifacts.schema: Launcher binding schemaVersion 1
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Console launcher
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore from private companion history and validate referenced installed runtime.

retention_rule.rule: Keep the current binding; never infer it from a development directory.

artifacts.purpose: Installed task declarations and source closure
artifacts.schema: Private runtime configuration, desired state, projections and observations
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Current binding and registration authority
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Keep referenced declarations and recovery closure in the private companion.

retention_rule.rule: Protected from generic cleanup; remove a declaration only after a separate reference and recovery review.

artifacts.purpose: One bounded final result, current handoff receipts and cleanup receipt
artifacts.schema: Markdown conclusion and schema_version 1 JSON receipts
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Operator review and current release handoff
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Version the concise final result; regenerate build payloads from committed sources.

retention_rule.rule: Replace the latest cleanup receipt; retain one final consolidated result under 256 KiB and the current release handoff only.

artifacts.schema: schema_version 1, at most 64 retirement entries and 256 KiB
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: tools/storage_retention.py and tools/cleanup_storage.ps1
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Reconstruct from the final result and source reconciliation; never infer approval from file age.

retention_rule.rule: Only completed, source-reconciled work with inactive writers and a retained result can enter the plan.

artifacts.purpose: Temporary builds, test environments and diagnostic outputs
artifacts.schema: Disposable build output with an explicit retirement record
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Committed source and bounded final result
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Rebuild from committed source and the installed artifact authority.

retention_rule.rule: Close and retire after source reconciliation and final acceptance; do not keep complete build copies as history.

artifacts.schema: Legacy artifacts explicitly listed in the private retirement record
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Consolidated final result and preserved useful tooling
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Committed source retains product changes; the latest handoff is preserved outside these trees.

retention_rule.rule: Only exact reviewed roots named by the retirement record may be removed after source reconciliation and writer/reference checks. This namespace has a bounded share of the combined 16 MiB legacy review budget.

artifacts.schema: Terminal session receipt, configuration and conclusion
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Bounded diagnostic conclusion
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Start a new explicit diagnostic session when fresh samples are needed.

retention_rule.rule: After the session is terminal and its writer is absent, retain its conclusion/configuration and retire raw samples explicitly.

artifacts.purpose: Private maintenance conclusions and displaced local telemetry
artifacts.schema: Bounded legacy telemetry and maintenance receipts
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Recoverable private maintenance state
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Keep in private companion history; never return runtime telemetry to the public tool.

retention_rule.rule: Preserve displaced original state until explicitly superseded; review above 1 MiB.
